import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 12345678;
    static int n, t;
    static char[][] grid = new char[1000][1000];
    static char[][] grid1 = new char[1000][1000];
    static int[][] d = new int[1000][1000];
    static int[][] d1 = new int[1000][1000];
    static List<Integer>[] v = new ArrayList[1000];
    static Cap[][] caps = new Cap[100][100];
    static int[] left = new int[1000];
    static int[] right = new int[1000];
    static int[] col = new int[1000];
    static Queue<Node> q = new LinkedList<>();

    static class Node {
        int i, j, no;
        Node(int i, int j, int no) {
            this.i = i;
            this.j = j;
            this.no = no;
        }
    }

    static class Cap {
        int[] no = new int[1001];
        int ind;
        int fl;
        Cap() {
            ind = 0;
            fl = 0;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                d[i][j] = INF;
                d1[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            grid[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            grid1[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    bfs(new Node(i, j, 0));
                }
            }
        }

        int mark = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid1[i][j])) {
                    int k = grid1[i][j] - '0';
                    if (k > 0) {
                        if (caps[i][j] == null) caps[i][j] = new Cap();
                        caps[i][j].fl = 1;
                        caps[i][j].ind = k;
                        for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                            caps[i][j].no[l] = mark++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        mark = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid[i][j])) {
                    int k = grid[i][j] - '0';
                    for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                        Node temp = new Node(i, j, mark++);
                        bfst(temp);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(match(mark - 1));
    }

    static boolean dfs(int s) {
        if (col[s] != 0) return false;
        col[s] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < v[s].size(); i++) {
            int k = v[s].get(i);
            if (left[k] == -1) {
                left[k] = s;
                right[s] = i;
                return true;
            } else if (dfs(left[k])) {
                left[k] = s;
                right[s] = i;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int match(int n) {
        Arrays.fill(left, -1);
        Arrays.fill(right, -1);
        int res = 0;
        boolean done;
        do {
            done = true;
            Arrays.fill(col, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                if (right[i] == -1 && dfs(i)) {
                    done = false;
                }
            }
        } while (!done);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (right[i] != -1) res++;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void bfst(Node s) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                d1[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        int i = s.i, j = s.j;
        d1[i][j] = 0;
        q.clear();
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Node temp = q.poll();
            int ti = temp.i, tj = temp.j;
            if (grid[ti][tj] == 'Y') continue;
            if (caps[ti][tj] != null && caps[ti][tj].fl == 1) {
                if (d1[ti][tj] <= t && d1[ti][tj] <= d[ti][tj]) {
                    for (int l = 1; l <= caps[ti][tj].ind; l++) {
                        v[s.no].add(caps[ti][tj].no[l]);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (d1[ti][tj] >= d[ti][tj]) continue;
            int[] di = {1, -1, 0, 0};
            int[] dj = {0, 0, 1, -1};
            for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; dir++) {
                int ni = ti + di[dir], nj = tj + dj[dir];
                if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n) {
                    if (d1[ni][nj] > d1[ti][tj] + 1) {
                        d1[ni][nj] = d1[ti][tj] + 1;
                        q.add(new Node(ni, nj, 0));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs(Node s) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                d[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        int i = s.i, j = s.j;
        d[i][j] = 0;
        q.clear();
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Node temp = q.poll();
            int ti = temp.i, tj = temp.j;
            int[] di = {1, -1, 0, 0};
            int[] dj = {0, 0, 1, -1};
            for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; dir++) {
                int ni = ti + di[dir], nj = tj + dj[dir];
                if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n) {
                    if (d[ni][nj] > d[ti][tj] + 1) {
                        d[ni][nj] = d[ti][tj] + 1;
                        q.add(new Node(ni, nj, 0));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
